overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation on either complaint allegation: the March 14 notice was specific enough, and withholding the town manager's name on the March 22 and 29 notices was reasonably justified. The AG separately raised, unprompted, that the March 22 and 29 executive session minutes lacked substance, and recommended amending them without making a violation finding.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the March 14 executive session notice was too vague because it listed 'other matters to be presented' regarding the Mayflower Wind cable.
allegations.key_passage: We are satisfied that this topic was listed on the meeting notice with sufficient specificity.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the March 22 and 29 notices were insufficiently specific because they did not name the non-union employee under discussion in contract strategy.
allegations.key_passage: Notwithstanding the general presumption that a public body should identify the specific nonunion personnel that is the subject of discussion under Purpose 2, here we are satisfied that the Board has demonstrated a reasonable basis for not identifying the town manager as the individual under discussion at that time.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board failed to review executive session minutes for possible public release on a regular basis as the Open Meeting Law requires.
allegations.key_passage: Nonetheless, based on a cursory review of several sets of meeting minutes from 2021 and 2022, we find numerous instances where the minutes document the Board’s review and vote whether to release executive session meeting minutes.

allegations.summary: Not raised in the complaint: the AG noted that the March 22 and 29 executive session minutes lacked substantive summaries of the discussion.
allegations.key_passage: The minutes of the Board’s March 22 and March 29 executive sessions—which were 72 and 30 minutes in length, respectively—include little more than a statement that the Board engaged in discussion about specified general topics, without any summary of the actual discussions.
